Hi, all! Thanks for reading! This was made using MTL (machine translation).

I really tried to do the best I could with the MTL. I triple-checked everything and edited it all to make it as accurate and smooth as possible. I’m not the biggest fan of MTL, mostly because 9/10 times the people doing it don’t put much effort into the translation, typesetting, or cleaning.

I hope I did an okay job! Thanks for reading, and have a great day!
